data.name: Dilipsinh
data.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh is derived from Sanskrit roots. Dili (दिलि) means 'Dharma' or 'righteousness'. Sinh (सिंह) means 'Lion'. This name represents the brave and just ruler, embodying the strength and courage of a lion and the wisdom and virtuousness of dharma.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength in righteousness and courage.

in_sanskrit.name: दिलीप्सिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh is derived from Sanskrit words 'दिल' (dil) meaning 'beloved, dear' and 'सिंह' (singh) meaning 'lion'. Thus, the name Dilipsinh can be translated to 'beloved lion' or 'dear lord'.
